name: Makhani-Rajas sauce (reduced tomato-butter-cream)
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED
method: Sweat onion in butter, add ginger-garlic paste and spices (cook 2 min), add passata.
Simmer, stirring, until reduced to about 57% of the raw weight (raw 1,371 g → about 780 g); thick enough to coat a spoon and hold a drawn line (Session 4 arm A).
Stir in cream and kasuri methi, simmer 3 min; add salt after reduction; chill completely before assembling.

sauce_spec.use: quesadilla filling; keep reduced so the tortilla stays crisp

food_safety: Cool to 5 °C within the 2 h + 4 h limits; chill before assembly so the filling does not steam the tortilla.
Date-mark and discard per the written policy.
evidence: food/sessions/S4-butter-chicken-quesadilla.md (T4 baseline: reduce to 55-60% of raw weight; salt after reduction)
estimates_label: All quantities, yields and shelf-life values are preliminary estimates until tested by a person in a kitchen.
